overview: A router picks the least-loaded GPU server directly (no queue) and proxies the gRPC token stream back over WebSockets; overload returns 429.

estimation.assumption: Illustrative service budget: 100 concurrent outputs at 30 tokens/s.
estimation.result: GPU sizing depends on model, sequence length, batching and measured token throughput.
estimation.implication: Admission control must consider tokens and KV-cache memory, not request count alone.

components.purpose: Choose a healthy GPU replica with available token capacity. Proxy WebSocket/gRPC token streams directly; reject overload with 429 and Retry-After rather than queueing.
components.rationale: Keep request handlers stateless where possible; the datastore or a fenced owner enforces concurrency invariants.

components.purpose: Store documents and their versioned lifecycle for llm chat service (chatgpt).
components.rationale: Index the access keys and use conditional updates for state changes; avoid unbounded embedded histories.

components.rationale: Assume retries; identify work stably, fence obsolete attempts and commit results before acknowledgement.

entityDetails.purpose: Conversation ownership and durable message history.
accessPatterns: Load an authorized prompt history; append user and assistant messages.
constraints: Bound context length and isolate user data.
relationships: Message records are partitioned by conversation_id; membership authorizes send and history access.

accessPatterns: Dedup request retries; finalize usage and cancellation.
constraints: Token chunks are transient unless explicitly persisted; never promise resumability from a missing chunk log.
relationships: conversation_id references the authorized Conversation; request_id distinguishes retries from new prompts.

apiDetails.purpose: Submit a prompt and stream generated tokens.
apiDetails.rationale: Reserve token budget, propagate cancellation, and dedup requestId. SSE works over HTTP; direct-router mode may proxy the same token events over WebSockets.

steps.title: Chat UI → API Gateway → Connection-aware inference router → Conversations
steps.explanation: Authorize, reserve token budget and persist the request.

steps.title: Connection-aware inference router → GPU inference replicas
steps.explanation: Choose available token/KV-cache capacity and proxy the response stream directly.

steps.title: Chat UI → API Gateway → Connection-aware inference router
steps.explanation: If every replica is full, return 429 with retry information; there is no durable inference queue.

steps.title: Connection-aware inference router → GPU inference replicas
steps.explanation: Propagate cancellation and release capacity; an interrupted generation is not silently resumed.

failureCases.scenario: GPU dies after streaming part of an answer
failureCases.handling: Mark the generation interrupted and settle measured usage. Retry creates a clearly identified new attempt; do not silently splice unrelated completions into the old stream.

alternatives: Use a bounded queue for short bursts and tier scheduling. Route directly for lower latency when callers tolerate immediate 429 rejection. Neither creates capacity during sustained overload.
